svg.title: RB2.1 — Product specs tab, from the Miro routine
svg.desc: Product specifications tab in the super panel: an Identity sub-tab, a Mechanical and electrical sub-tab listing component groups, and a selected component showing its 2D drawing with the model highlighting it.
svg.text: 200 x 150 x 60 mm · measured on the demonstrator, not the declared product size
PRODUCT SPECS · MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL — component groups
pinch a part, or pick from the list
COMPONENT SELECTED — 2D drawing + data, model highlights the part
Aluminium shell + Cu contacts, Au/Ni plated
Au 91.7 mg plating · Ni 500 mg underplating
Read from the Miro routine: SPECS sits inside IDENTITY; components are a THIRD level under Mechanical/Electrical;
each component shows a 2D DRAWING except screws. Tabs renamed: Usage history -> Usage & service.
NEW ASSET COST: seven 2D component drawings do not exist. They are the only thing on this tab with no data behind it.
11 components are grouped to 8 rows (PCB substrate + copper + solder = PCB; coating + misc merged) so the list fits one screen.
The 200 x 150 x 60 size is the DEMONSTRATOR measured, not the declared product (166 x 121 x 41, Bosch sheet 234686731).
Recycler walkthrough: later tabs dimmed, CTA reads Next. Product user sees all four lit and Scan next product.
